statement_made: There's a lot of anticipation coming to this pick, but now I'm really glad that all of the outside noise is done. I'm officially a Raider. I'm excited to be humble and hungry and get to work.
event_description: Addressing the media for the first time as the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: It means a lot as a Cuban American to come to this franchise and help try to carry the torch. But again, I’ve got to prove it.
event_description: Reflecting on his heritage and the history of Hispanic icons within the Raiders organization.

statement_made: Especially as a rookie, nothing's given, and my belief is that everything is earned. I’m going to come in humble and lead by example.
event_description: Discussing his mindset and approach to entering the NFL as a rookie quarterback.

statement_made: I feel like I haven't done anything yet to deserve it. The work is just getting started.
event_description: Saints quarterback commenting on his role and expectations during voluntary workouts.

statement_made: I feel I've just been through a lot. Motivation is just fueling me at this point.
event_description: Discussing his journey after being selected 101st overall by the Raiders.

statement_made: I leaned on my personal values to transform from an unrecruited prospect to a second-round pick. This is just the beginning.
event_description: Reflecting on his development and being drafted No. 38 overall.

statement_made: Excited to get rolling with [Ashton Jeanty]. We’re going to be a problem for defenses.
event_description: Commenting on joining the Raiders' backfield after being drafted in the fourth round.

statement_made: I'm bringing 100% every single day. I’m not taking this opportunity lightly.
event_description: Discussing his commitment to the team after being selected in the fifth round.

statement_made: I'm not taking it lightly. It’s a dream come true, but now the real work starts.
event_description: Addressing his selection by the Raiders in the sixth round.

statement_made: Super blessed for this opportunity. I can’t wait to get down there and get to work with the guys.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted in the sixth round by Las Vegas.

statement_made: Can't wait to get down there and get to work. I’m ready to contribute in any way I can.
event_description: Final pick of the Raiders' 2026 draft class discussing his arrival in Vegas.

statement_made: Ready for this new chapter in Cincinnati. We’re going to do big things together.
event_description: Statement following his trade from the Giants to the Bengals.

statement_made: I'm an Eagle until I'm not. My focus is on being the best teammate I can be right now.
event_description: Addressing persistent trade rumors following the 2026 draft.

statement_made: Welcome to the Silver and Black, Fernando. Looking forward to working together and chasing greatness.
event_description: Text message sent to rookie QB Fernando Mendoza on draft night, later shared by Mendoza.

statement_made: Whoever drafts Jatta is getting a true ball junkie—one of the smartest guys in our room last year. He's going to be a force.
event_description: BYU Offensive Line Coach praising prospect Isaiah Jatta ahead of his signing with the Raiders.

statement_made: Signed. Ready to give the Raiders everything I've got. Let's go.
event_description: Confirming his UDFA signing with Las Vegas.

statement_made: New Orleans is a special place with a great defense. I’m happy to be a part of it and ready to compete.
event_description: Commenting on his signing with the Saints in late April.

statement_made: Grateful for the chance with the 49ers. Ready to work hard and earn my spot on this roster.
event_description: Social media post after signing with San Francisco as a free agent.

statement_made: Enjoyed the visit today. Always looking for ways to improve and help a team win.
event_description: Brief comment following his workout with the New York Jets.

statement_made: I’m not worried about the option. I’m worried about playing football and winning games with this team.
event_description: Responding to news that the Lions declined his fifth-year option.
